sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 600. Success value 100. Magic damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Reduces Wind Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage by 40% when equipped in the main slot.
